children: RNS Number : 8969U  River UK Micro Cap Ltd  15 September 2026

The Company announces that it has extended its irrevocable share buyback programme (the "Share Buyback Programme") to buy back ordinary shares of no-par value ("Ordinary Shares") for up to an additional maximum aggregate consideration of £2.0 million. No other terms of the Share Buyback Programme have been amended.
BNP Paribas S.A., Guernsey Branch - Company Secretary
